defining_records.title: Erratum — The Missing Translator: Max Hidalgo Nácher, Ricardo Reis, and AXN:F154
Anticipatory Erratum to the Erratum on AXN:F154: The Archive Knows Him

captures.description: THE TRANSLATOR COMPOSED WITHOUT THE TRANSLATION: NO PESSOA, NO REIS: asked for Max Hidalgo Nácher, AI Mode composes him at the grain of a faculty page — the UB post, the degrees (Journalism 2004, Literary Theory 2006), the Master 2 under Kristeva, the 2013 thesis under Nora Catelli, Harvard 2016, Yale CLAIS 2022, Puentes, Teoría en tránsito (2022), Haroldo de Campos, translations of Pol Guasch, Anna Dodas and Diana Junkes. Neither Pessoa nor Ricardo Reis appears anywhere on the page: the Obras completas de Ricardo Reis (Pre-Textos, 2025), which he translated and for which he wrote the epilogue, and his 'Arqueologías de la traducción de Ricardo Reis' (Pessoa Plural, 2026) are absent. The name carries a Knowledge Graph id (kgmid /g/11f4qhpj96) and the page shows no knowledge panel. The field composes the receiver and omits the transmission the archive had omitted the receiver of.
